title: Tensor by a completed rank-one line preserves derived completeness.
statement:
The theorem `WeilConjectures.integralLineTensor_complete` has the following exact Lean type. It is the strict intermediate interface used by the parent proposition:

theorem integralLineTensor_complete
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] (S : Scheme.{u})
    (L : scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E S)
    [SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u + 1, u, u + 1} L 1]
    [(SheafOfModules.siteSheafTensorRight.{u, u + 1, u + 1, u + 1}
      (A := completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted.{u, u} l E S) L).Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (SheafOfModules.siteSheafTensorRight.{u, u + 1, u + 1, u + 1}
      (A := completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted.{u, u} l E S) L)]
    [PreservesFiniteColimits (SheafOfModules.siteSheafTensorRight.{u, u + 1, u + 1, u + 1}
      (A := completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted.{u, u} l E S) L)]
    (K : DerivedCategory.{u + 2} (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E S))
    (hK : IsSfDerivedComplete l E S K) :
    IsSfDerivedComplete l E S
      ((SheafOfModules.siteSheafTensorRight.{u, u + 1, u + 1, u + 1}
        (A := completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted.{u, u} l E S) L).mapDerivedCategory.obj
          K)

proof.text: Choose a prime p greater than l+1, and the standard finite-field datum with base ZMod p and its algebraic closure, so l differs from its characteristic. By sfDerivedComplete_iff_legacy, hK supplies a witness of IsDerivedCompleteUnrestricted. Apply the already stated CompletedLineTensor.complete at exponent one. Its signed power is definitionally L, since scalarTensorPower has degree-one value L, so its derived tensor functor is exactly the functor of the conclusion (proof-instance choices are irrelevant). Unpack the resulting unrestricted-completeness witness and use sfDerivedComplete_iff_legacy in the reverse direction. No hypothesis about boundedness, finite reductions or the residue characteristics of S is introduced.

source.place: Proof (3), tensor inverse and integral completion; the already stated CompletedLineTensor.complete clause, whose proof is recorded in its docstring.

proof_origin.place: Y2: specialize the existing signed-line completeness theorem to exponent one, transporting through the proved legacy comparison.
